faqList.title: What's the smallest amount I can deposit?
faqList.text: The minimum starts at A$10 with a Neosurf voucher. PayID, cards and most e-wallets need at least A$20, while a bank transfer requires A$100. Keep in mind that each welcome bonus stage has its own minimum deposit to qualify.

faqList.title: What should I know before playing at Crown Casino Perth?
faqList.text: You need a player card for every machine, and you set time and loss limits before your first spin. Play is capped at 12 hours a day and 48 hours a week. Bring photo ID, as staff can ask for it at any time.

faqList.title: Do I have to gamble to enjoy the resort?
faqList.text: No, most of each resort has nothing to do with gaming. Hotels, hatted restaurants, spas, shows and events fill most of the floor space. Many guests never set foot on the gaming floor.

faqList.title: Which withdrawal method is the quickest at Crown Casino online Australia?
faqList.text: Crypto pays out the fastest, with XRP, Solana and Tron arriving in under five minutes. PayID comes next and lands within 24 hours. Cards and bank transfers take between one and five business days.

faqList.title: Where can I get help if gambling stops being fun?
faqList.text: Visit a PlaySafe centre, open 24 hours a day at all three resorts. Staff can set up self-exclusion or connect you with counselling. You can also call PlaySafe on 1800 801 098 or Gambling Help on 1800 858 858.
